CAREER OBJECTIVE
Seeking a career in Networking and related systems in a challenging
environment that would give me the opportunity to bring out the best in me and
for continuous improvement that leads to the growth of the organization.
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Having 6 years of Experience on Network Administration that includes designing, deploying, troubleshooting and maintaining of networks in LAN, WAN environment.
Hands of experience on configuration of Switches and Router.  Having good knowledge of Cisco ASR 1000, 9000, 9400, 3600,3500 series switches and Arista DSC 7K routers and Juniper routers MX240, MX80, SRX4200 and SRX5600 FW and PA-5250 FW.
Hands on experience on wireless Cisco and Aruba controllers and APs.  Highly productive in team environment as both members. Efficient in handling multiple project priorities.

raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Technical Summary:
LAN, WAN, IPv4 addressing, IPv4 Sub netting.  Ethernet header, ipv4 header, TCP header.  OSI reference model and TCP/IP reference model.  Ping, Traceroute, ACL.  ARP, ICMP, UDP, TCP, SSH, Telnet, DHCP, DNS.
Security Technologies:
SSL, IPSec, VPN, Firewall, NAT.
Routing Technologies:
Static Routing, Dynamic Routing, Default Routing  Routing Protocols such as OSPF, BGP, MPLS
Switching Technologies:
VLAN, VTP, STP, RSTP.

ORGANIZATION: Capgemini Technology Services India Limited (September 2024- 
ORGANIZATION: Tata Consultancy Services Private Limited (Jan 2022 – August 2024).
PROJECT: Microsoft.
DESIGNATION: Systems Engineer.
Roles And Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting the routing protocols such as IS-IS, OSPF and BGP.  Primary Incident management Troubleshoot and resolve all network related incidents.
Will raise the ticket with product vendors and coordinate to resolve the issues.  Will create an ISP ticket such as AT&T, Lumen, Orange, Airtel etc., and coordinate with them to resolve the issue and will prepare RCA and submit to respective team.
To configure and troubleshooting the protocols such OSPF and static routes.  To Trouble hardware related issues and raise RMA if hardware issue identified and create a ticket with Cisco and Aruba TAC team and resolves the issue accordingly.
Execution of iOS Upgrades, Security patches and bug fixes.  Provisioning and an end-to-end troubleshooting of Cisco and Aruba Access Points.  Troubleshooting includes assisting Data Center tech and providing step by step physical investigation process.
 Scheduling the Work Windows to the site services teams to trouble shoot the issues
on POE switches, AP related issues and device replacements.
ORGANIZATION: AGS Private Limited (Mar 2019 – Jan 2022).
DESIGNATION: Junior Associate.
Role: Network Engineer.
Roles And Responsibilities:
Monitoring the device health status every day and documented the information,  To configure and troubleshoot the MX80 and MX240 devices.  Configuring the default routes for respective ISP’s.  If we found any hardware issue, we will create a ticket with Juniper TAC team and resolves the issue accordingly and Collecting RSI and Var/logs to analyze issue.
Junos upgrade on MX device  GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover) and NSR (Non-Stop Routing).
PERSONAL SKILLS
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Team facilitator, Ability to deal with people diplomatically.  Willingness to learn, fast learner and Strong leadership skills  Able to give the best result in pressure situations.
ACADEMIC PROFILE
 Pursued B.Tech in the stream of Electronics and Communication Engineering from Ravindra College of engineering for women, affiliated to JNTU-Anantapur, during 2014-2018 with an aggregate of 62.58%.
 Intermediate from master’s Junior college of Arts and Science affiliated to board of Intermediate Education A.P, during 2012-2014 with an aggregate of 82.8%.
 S.S.C from St. Joseph’s English medium High School affiliated to Board of Secondary School Education, A.P during 2011-2012 with an aggregate of 8.7 GPA
